name: jamovi_create_omv
description: Convert a CSV or Excel dataset into a native jamovi (.omv) project file with custom column metadata (measurement levels, factor labels).

output_omv_path.description: Destination path for the generated .omv file.

column_types.description: Optional mapping of column name to measurement scale: 'Nominal', 'Ordinal', or 'Continuous'.

test_type.description: Optional initial analysis to embed: 'correlation', 'ttest_is', 'anova', etc.

variables.description: Optional variables for embedded initial analysis.

group_var.description: Optional grouping variable for embedded initial analysis.

include_plots.description: Whether to include pre-rendered visual plots.
